name: Raw | 20 Count Cones
description: RAW’s goal is to make the world’s best rolling papers, and they have done a great job at turning their brand into a household name. RAW papers and cones are unbleached and unrefined for a delicious smoke. This 20-pack of pre-rolled king size cones is a great deal for customers who love to pack their own cones.
